name: Stretch Go-Go
summary: A Go-Go variant where the virtual arm keeps growing while the real hand is held in an outer zone, so reach is unlimited.
howItWorks: The space in front of the user is divided into concentric zones. Holding the hand in the outermost zone makes the virtual arm extend at a constant rate, the innermost zone retracts it, and the middle zone holds its length; a gauge shows the current zone.

relationships.note: Replaces Go-Go's position mapping with rate control.
